rows.grounds: Refers back to the four divisions mentioned previously; indicates possession or relation to them.
Prescribes a ritual or preparatory action to be performed on the specified parts.
Fused form comprising bhāgān (parts), agrayoḥ (at-the-two-tips), ubhayoḥ (of-both), and imān (these); specifies the portions to be swept.

items.question: Which specific portions of those divisions must be swept away at both ends?
premises: The prior division yields four parts measured in sequence.
A sweeping action is prescribed for portions belonging to those divisions.
The targeted portions are identified as these parts at both tips.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner must sweep away these specified parts located at both ends of those divisions.
uncertainties: The exact physical or diagrammatic referent of the tips depends on the ritual context of the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: One should sweep away these parts of them at both tips.
